A versatile, everyday choice, the Tuscan Court Shoe is an ode to the old-school kicks Todd’s known and loved over the years. A menswear staple, “court shoes” were originally designed for wearing on tennis or basketball courts (hence the name), but have become ubiquitous on feet everywhere thanks to their sporty look. That timeless silhouette gets an upgrade here with luxe leather uppers and Vachetta leather accents that play against the shoe’s clean lines. Our deconstructed take pairs just as well with light-wash denim and a tee as it does with chinos and a button-down. Premium details include brogue-style stitching and a suede “mudguard” before the vamp for a little extra protection. The whole affair is comfortably grounded in a cork footbed and a solid rubber EVA sole.
